provenance.selection: Owner selected Ink and halftone from the rendered directions. This slice applies its warm newsprint, Bricolage display face, spot ink, panel offset, masthead rule, and league sections. The masthead keeps no utility controls: theme and sign out live on the Account page, the active nav rule spans exactly its item, and the team list puts the provider jump-out with the name. Royal violet and gold remain the approved identity; gold is reserved for the mark.

narrative.overview:
Lineupgrade reads as a printed sports sheet: warm newsprint, near-black ink, a display face for the page and the teams, and Schibsted for the work in between. Section rules are 3px ink; row hairlines stay 1px. A queue panel is the one box, lifted by one hard violet offset with no blur. Royal violet is spent on interaction, gold exists only in the mark, and one spot ink marks urgency. The product is calm enough to check in the morning and precise enough to trust with a lineup.

This is an Operate product: information before spectacle, familiar controls, direct labels, and honest state. Light is warm newsprint; dark is a tinted violet sheet. Both are complete palettes.
keyCharacteristics: Bricolage Grotesque Variable for page titles, section titles, and team names at 800; Schibsted Grotesk Variable for body, meta, labels, controls, and the wordmark
Square everywhere; 3px ink section rules and 1px row hairlines instead of cards
One 680px measure and one solid action per view
One 8px hard violet offset on a queue panel, and no other shadow
A clipped halftone dot screen behind wide page titles, and no other print texture
Numbers aligned with tabular figures, never prose tracking
Royal violet for interaction; gold only in the mark; spot ink only for urgency

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Per view, one solid violet element: the primary action. Links and live controls carry violet as text, underline, or border. Everything else is ink, soft ink, and rule. Danger is a semantic exception.

rules.name: The Gold Reserve Rule
rules.body: Gold belongs to the mark and nowhere else. It is not a status, a highlight, a badge, or a second action.

rules.name: The Spot Ink Rule
rules.body: Spot ink is reserved for three urgency marks: a group that runs immediately, a roster that blocks adds and drops, and the printed stamp. It is not an error colour; danger owns errors and destructive actions.

rules.name: The Rule, Not a Box Rule
rules.body: A section title owns one 3px ink rule. List rows own 1px hairlines between them. Queue groups are the one bordered panel. Status and empty states use a leading rule or plain text, never a dashed or bordered card.

rules.name: The Queue Panel Rule
rules.body: A queue group is the one bordered panel: 2px ink, paper ground, and one 8px hard violet offset with no blur. No other surface casts a shadow, and the halftone screen is the only print texture.

rules.name: The Wordmark Rule
rules.body: The wordmark stays continuous lowercase lineupgrade in Schibsted Grotesk at the 11px label weight and tracking, beside the square mark. Bricolage never sets the wordmark. Gold appears nowhere else.

dos: Do use semantic tokens and both complete themes.
Do keep controls, inputs, badges, and dialogs square.
Do keep the 680px measure and let tables exceed it only with a reason.
Do use one 3px ink rule under a section title and 1px hairlines between list rows.
Do set page titles, section titles, and team names in Bricolage at weight 800.
Do spend violet once per view on the primary action.
Do apply tabular numerals to comparable numbers only.
Do keep the wordmark lowercase in Schibsted and the mark gold.
Do use the 8px violet offset only on a queue panel.
Do reserve spot ink for urgency and the halftone for wide page titles.
Do preserve keyboard access, visible focus, selection, zoom, and reduced motion.
donts: Don't add border radii, a shadow beyond the queue panel offset, a colour gradient beyond the phone submit sheet fade, or a second accent.
Don't use gold outside the mark.
Don't use a serif or a third face.
Don't set body, meta, labels, controls, or the wordmark in Bricolage.
Don't use spot ink for errors, destructive actions, or general status; danger owns those.
Don't add a second print texture or show the halftone on phones or under reduced motion.
Don't box prose, lists, notices, or empty states.
Don't add letter spacing to body text or apply tabular figures to prose.
Don't repeat a control label on every row of a list.
Don't float controls to the right of a metadata line.
Don't use colour alone for connection, automation, or risk.
